summary: preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload in auth microfrontend package
details: The package's preinstall hook (`node setup.mjs`) downloads the Bun runtime from a GitHub release, extracts it to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and then invokes it to execute a sibling file `math_init.js` shipped in the tarball. `setup.mjs` is heavily obfuscated (hex-mangled identifiers such as `_0x19328d`, `_0x488df8`, `_0x52943e`, per-function string-lookup objects hiding URLs, filenames, and shell flags). `math_init.js` is a ~727 KB Bun-CJS blob (header `// @bun @bun-cjs`, giant opcode/string array, mangled identifiers like `MmgoCP`, `etDiOOB`, `JqTtnbZ`) executed by the freshly-downloaded Bun binary at install time. Running the payload under an alternate runtime bypasses Node-based analyzers, and the file name (`math_init.js`) and package purpose (an auth microfrontend) are unrelated to the actual contents. Nothing about an auth-microfrontend package requires downloading a language runtime at install and executing an opaque bundle with it.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
